description: This file defines the GitlabResourceOwner class, implementing OAuth2 resource owner interface for GitLab integration. It manages user information and provides methods for API client access, user details, and status checks.

classes.name: GitlabResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a GitLab user obtained via OAuth2, providing user details and API client access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with response data and access token.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the user.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Provides an authenticated GitLab API client instance, requiring the external Gitlab package.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain associated with the resource owner.

methods.name: setDomain
methods.description: Sets the domain for the resource owner.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the owner.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the owner.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address of the owner.

methods.name: getAvatarUrl
methods.description: Returns the avatar URL of the owner.

methods.name: getProfileUrl
methods.description: Returns the profile URL of the owner.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the user is active.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin privileges.

methods.name: isExternal
methods.description: Checks if the user is external.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all user data as an array.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve data from the internal data array with optional default.
